Preston startup raises £900,000 to digitise school catering

A Preston startup has raised £900,000 to digitise school catering, its founder confirmed this week.

The company's platform handles meal choices, dietary allergies and kitchen stock for more than 300 schools.

The founder said the funding round closes at the end of the month and that the team will grow from six to fifteen people.

The startup's name was confirmed by the regional growth hub, which supported the raise.
